Excalidraw Keyboard Shortcuts

85 keyboard shortcuts to help you sketch diagrams quickly faster in Excalidraw

From Excalidraw Community, Excalidraw is purpose-built to sketch diagrams quickly. It is one of the leading applications in the collaboration & whiteboards category.

Efficient Excalidraw workflows rely heavily on keyboard shortcuts. Every second saved on navigation adds up over the course of a project.

Cross-platform availability on macOS, Windows, and Linux means Excalidraw shortcuts are relevant to a large and diverse user base.
